title: Lab sprint briefing — January 10 2027
content:
Purpose:
Quick sync-style briefing for the applied-ml lab sprint (week of Jan 10). This is a lightweight capture: experiments, blockers, action items, and a short risk/impact view to share with product and infra partners. Not exhaustive — treat as the single-page update for the week.

Attendees (sync 11:00): Priya (owner), Evan, Sofia, Liam, Mei. Quick standup highlights at the top.

1) Running experiments (progress + early signals)
- Quant probe: 8-bit mixed (Q4->Q8 hybrid) on small-batch Llama-2-13B baseline.
  - Config: per-channel symmetric, s8 hybrid fallback for MatMul layers.
  - Early signal: latency down ~42% on A100p4-preemptible; PPL delta negligible on short-form prompts (<0.6%). Memory footprint reduction matched infra estimate.
  - Next: validate on long-context (4k tokens) and run prompt-sensitivity sweep for completion tasks (Sofia).

- KV-cache delta test: swapped cache shard routing (round-robin -> affinity by user-hash).
  - Result: tail latency P99 improved for heavy-sessions by ~18% when affinity hit rate > 0.7.
  - Note: affinity increases cache hotness; need eviction policies to avoid clobbering small sessions. (Liam to prototype LFU variant).

- Eval harness: end-to-end fidelity checks for quantized model variants.
  - Running eval-suite (semantic similarity, instruction-following, hallucination probes) as nightly job. First 24-hr run flagged higher hallucination on one instruction class (multi-step reasoning with numeric constraints).
  - Hypothesis: quantization noise in attention normalization exacerbates rounding on chained arithmetic.
  - Short term mitigation: fall back to fp16 for final feed-forward in that instruction class via routing policy. (Mei to add rule to eval config).

2) Model onboarding status (incoming model: community-13B-2027a)
- Integration tasks completed: model artifact validation, config mapping, tokenizer sanity checks.
- Remaining: compile-time kernel profile for causal self-attention on 2D-sharded layout (blocked by release-engineering infra seat until Jan 13).
- Risk: if kernel profile misses optimizations, throughput will be 20–30% lower vs expectation — need contingency routes to a compatible quantized variant.

3) Open blockers and asks to other teams
- Release-eng: need access to ephemeral fleet for kernel profiling; assigned RWD-2172 (Evan).
- Infra: request to increase ephemeral GPU quota for nightly evals (Jan 11-13) by +8 A100p4 nodes; cost approved but needs infra uplift (ticket RWD-2147).
- Product/Console: telemetry event to capture per-request quantization-variant tag (small schema change). Product owner asked for a one-line spec by Jan 12. (Priya owning).

4) Short experiment plan (this sprint)
- A: Long-context quantization validation (Sofia). Run 1000-case sample, compare prefix cache behavior and rollout regression. Deadline Jan 14.
- B: LFU eviction prototype + sim on recorded workload (Liam). Smoke test by Jan 13.
- C: Eval-suite add numeric-consistency test and auto-fallback rule prototype (Mei). Jan 15.
- D: Kernel-profile follow-up for community-13B (Evan + release-eng). Jan 16.

5) Acceptance criteria & success metrics (for this sprint)
- Quant variant accepted if: average latency reduction >=30% and semantic-similarity delta <=0.8% vs fp16 baseline across curated prompt set.
- KV-cache routing change accepted if overall P95 improves and session fairness metric (95th percentile per-user token throughput) not degraded by >5%.
- Model onboarding green if integration tests + kernel-profile throughput are within 15% of targeted spec.

6) Quick notes & thoughts (informal)
- We should avoid a hard rollout on the community-13B until we have the numeric-consistency test passed — observed failure mode looks correlated to long chains of addition/subtraction in instruction-following prompts.
- Consider short-circuiting to a FP16 microservice for numeric-critical flows (route by prompt tag) — cost vs correctness tradeoff needs quantifying but could ship faster than re-training/quant fixes.
- There are multiple small PRs touching the tensor-quant layer — consolidate into a single review batch to avoid repeated infra churn.

7) Action items (who, by when)
- Priya: spec for telemetry event for quant_variant tag; Jan 12.
- Evan: follow up on RWD-2172 with release-eng and secure profiling seat; Jan 13.
- Sofia: run long-context sweep and post result summary in the ticket; Jan 14.
- Liam: LFU prototype and sim report; Jan 13.
- Mei: extend eval-suite with numeric-consistency probe + auto-fallback rule; Jan 15.

8) Backlog / nice-to-have (not blocking current sprint)
- Integrate simulated-batching agent into the eval harness for more realistic throughput metrics.
- Investigate mixed-precision fine-grain (per-layer fp16/8) scheduling to handle numeric-critical layers.
- Formalize rollback playbook for quantized rollouts in Console (canary -> immediate rollback triggers).

9) References and quick links (tickets/PRs/docs)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/kv-cache/pull/412 (cache routing change)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/model-zoo/pull/89 (community-13B onboarding)
- Tickets: RWD-2147 (infra quota), RWD-2172 (kernel profiling)
- Confluence: onboarding checklist and preflight tests page (linked above)

Notes to self: keep this doc short and refile weekly; create a one-line summary for the external sprint digest (product + infra) once Liams LFU sim is stable.

-- end --
